mapper.sql: FROM RW LEFT JOIN OCUOC_LFMAP_L P ON P.WK_ID = RW.WK_ID AND P.LEFRM_ID = RW.LEFRM_ID AND P.FILD_KEY = RW.FILD_KEY WHERE NVL(P.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
mapper.update: /* [OCR업무사용신청] 매핑 저장 - updateUsage */ MERGE INTO OCUOC_LFMAP_L T USING (SELECT #{wkId} AS WK_ID , #{lefrmId} AS LEFRM_ID , #{readItem} AS FILD_KEY FROM DUAL) S ON (T.WK_ID = S.WK_ID AND T.LEFRM_ID = S.LEFRM_ID AND T.FILD_KEY = S.FILD_KEY) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.SCN_NO = #{dispNumber} , T.MAPP_INFO = #{mappingInfo} , T.DISP_ORD = #{dispOrd} , T.EDTR_ID = #{userId} , T.CHNG_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (WK_ID, LEFRM_ID, FILD_KEY, FILD_NM, SCN_NO, MAPP_INFO, DISP_ORD, USE_YN, RGSR_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (S.WK_ID, S.LEFRM_ID, S.FILD_KEY, S.FILD_KEY, #{dispNumber}, #{mappingInfo}, #{dispOrd}, 'Y', #{userId}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.insert:
SELECT TEST_OCR_APPLY_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TEST_OCR_APPLY (APPLY_ID, OCR_DOC, OCR_CODE, APPLY_REASON, APPLY_USER_ID, APPLY_USER_NM, STATUS, CREATE_DATE) VALUES (#{applyId}, #{ocrDoc}, #{ocrCode}, #{applyReason}, #{applyUserId}, #{applyUserNm}, 'REQ', SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO TEST_OCR_APPLY_LINE (APPLY_ID, SEQ, APPR_USER_ID, APPR_USER_NM, APPR_STATUS) VALUES (#{applyId}, #{seq}, #{apprUserId}, #{apprUserNm}, 'WAIT')
